entry.title: Digest: 2026-11-28
entry.summary: Futurum Careers, a science-education publication, profiles research by Dr Paul Koch of the University of Wisconsin–Madison on fungicides used on turfgrass. In Futurum's account, fungicides can have negative side-effects, known as non-target effects.

entry.title: Digest: 2026-11-18
entry.summary: The watch's first run. The City of Alexandria says its ban on gas leaf blowers took effect November 17. A new review of the German Lawn Research Project by Norbert Müller and Maria Ignatieva (Urban Ecosystems) reports that frequently mowed lawns support less plant diversity and wildlife value than meadows.
